invariants.name: composition_steady_no_commits
invariants.note: DirectComposition is retained. Once a window settles, continuous GPU frames must publish no transaction. Missing stays not-evaluable.

invariants.name: composition_steady_no_tree_mutations
invariants.note: Nothing may be staged on the visual tree by a frame whose geometry did not move.

invariants.name: composition_steady_no_region_rebuilds
invariants.note: A settled scene revision reuses the regions it already produced; nothing rescans the node list.

invariants.name: composition_steady_no_regions_considered
invariants.note: A settled frame produces no regions at all, because it never runs the extraction that would produce them.

invariants.name: composition_steady_no_regions_changed
invariants.note: No region reaches a backend again. Implied by no rebuilds, kept separate so a rescan that stages is still caught.

invariants.name: composition_steady_no_chrome_writes
invariants.note: Moving or presenting a window is not a style change, so the host reconciles no native chrome. Covers the move-only leg of the same run.

notes: Windows host acceptance for the retained DirectComposition contract. Counters are deltas measured after the window settles, from `RuntimeProgramContext::composition_work()`; the probe is `nana-ui --example native-content-probe`. Requires real Windows hardware with a DX12 adapter: there is no synthetic substitute, and a run that cannot reach a composition target must report unsupported rather than zeros. Not an Issue #8 §8.1 catalog id and not a weekly DoD gate.
